_doc: Balanced 8-channel scenario: medium budget, no infeasibility traps. Solver should produce a meaningfully better allocation than greedy.
_expected_outcome: Solver finds an optimal mix that respects dependencies + min compounding + min fast-feedback. Greedy would over-concentrate budget on top-scored items.
_optimum_note: Calibrated against the canonical linear-allocation template on 2026-05-19. Objective is Σ score[i] × sqrt(spend[i]) post-solve, NOT the solver's PWL-approximated objective. Values are budget-allocation-aware (5+ active channels using ~$35K). If solver returns >5% off this number, the template encoding has drifted.
